title: Accessible Page Capture
summary: Record an access barrier and export a private issue packet.
user: Low-vision workers and colleagues who need to report one inaccessible web interaction with enough evidence to fix it.
smallest_useful_product: A browser extension that records an explicit 30-second interaction trace, page URL, focused element labels, and an optional user note, then exports a redacted Markdown or JSON issue packet.
constraints: Recording starts and stops only after an explicit action.
Typed values and password fields are never recorded.
The extension must work with a keyboard and screen reader.
Do not make legal conformance claims.
